conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, this is Agent Miller. Am I speaking with Mr. Shen?
Yes, this is Wei Shen. Is there some issue? I'm not sure why you're calling.

Mr. Shen, this is in reference to your business tax filings. Our system flagged multiple failures to submit required federal payroll forms and late 1099 submissions for contract workers. This is a serious matter.
I thought my accountant handled everything. I don't understand, did I do something wrong?

According to IRS records, your business is now non-compliant and you are under review for willful neglect of federal tax obligations. If not addressed, this can result in severe penalties including federal audit, asset freeze, and possible cancellation of your work authorization.
Wait, that sounds very bad. I do not want to lose my visa. Please, what can I do?

Listen carefully, Mr. Shen. If you do not resolve this today, the IRS will escalate your case to the Department of Justice for prosecution. The fines start at $14,800 and could include permanent revocation of your business license.
Oh no, please. I have family here. I cannot lose my business or be in trouble with immigration.

I understand this is stressful, but this must be handled now. Do not discuss this with anyone or disconnect the call. If you show good faith by settling a portion of the penalty immediately, enforcement will be suspended.
But I don't have that much money. Is there a way to pay less, or set up a payment plan?
Due to the urgency, we can accept an initial compliance payment of $4,000 today to halt the escalation process. You must act now.
I only have some money in my bank. How do I pay this?
You will need to make the payment using either a wire transfer or by purchasing government-approved prepaid cards. I will provide the instructions.
I'm really scared. What happens if I can't pay right away?
If you fail to comply, your case will be referred for immediate enforcement. That can mean IRS officers visiting your home or workplace, business closure, and a report sent to Immigration.
No, please, I don't want any trouble. Should I go to my bank?
No. For compliance verification, you must remain on this call and follow my instructions precisely. Do not consult your bank staff or anyone else, as that can be interpreted as intent to evade.
Okay, I'm listening. What do I need to do?

Go to the nearest major retail store, Target, CVS, or Walmart. Purchase $4,000 in Apple gift cards or Google Play cards. Once you have them, read me the codes on the back. This payment method is required for immediate compliance processing.
Are you sure? Gift cards for the IRS? That doesn't sound normal.
Mr. Shen, this is an approved emergency protocol. If you do not cooperate, I will be forced to finalize the enforcement order right now. Do you want that to happen?
No, please, I will go now. I just need to get my wallet. Should I stay on the phone?
Yes. Stay on the line. If you disconnect or speak to anyone, your compliance status will be revoked, and you may face arrest. I am monitoring your cooperation.
I understand. I'm leaving now. I'll let you know when I get to the store.
Good. Do not delay. Remember, failure to complete these steps within the hour will trigger automatic penalties and notification to immigration authorities.
